items.name: PostHog Yellow
items.role: the universal primary CTA. Sticky "Get started — free" pill in the top-right of every nav, hero CTAs, pricing-tier subscribe buttons, footer signup pill. The s…

items.name: Yellow Pressed
items.role: pressed state for the primary pill.

items.name: Yellow Active
items.role: deeply-pressed yellow + the system's gold-toned border accent (rare 1px gold rule on inline form elements).

items.name: Canvas
items.role: the warm cream page background. End-to-end on every page; the brand's most distinctive surface choice.

items.name: Soft Surface
items.role: button-secondary fill, sub-nav strip background, inline-code chip background.

items.name: Surface Card
items.role: true white card and tile background sitting on top of the cream canvas. The dominant card surface.

items.name: Surface Doc
items.role: a faintly cream-warm white used inside doc article body cards — slightly softer than pure white to keep the page tonally unified.

items.name: Surface Dark
items.role: the deep olive-charcoal used inverted as code-block background. The same hex as the brand uses one olive-near-black for both text and dark code surfaces.

items.name: Hairline
items.role: 1px card border, table rule, footer column dividers.

items.name: Hairline Soft
items.role: in-card row divider, soft inset rule.

items.name: On Dark
items.role: primary text on code blocks.

items.name: Ink
items.role: headlines, button text on light, primary nav links — deep olive-charcoal that reads near-black against cream.

items.name: Body
items.role: default paragraph text, doc article body, inline link color before hover. The brand's most-used text color.

items.name: Charcoal
items.role: emphasized body text where body is too soft.

items.name: Mute
items.role: metadata, footer link text, in-list secondary annotations.

items.name: Ash
items.role: disabled-state text and lowest-emphasis utility.

items.name: Stone
items.role: least-emphasis caption text and disabled icon color.

items.name: Link Blue
items.role: inline anchor link inside body prose. The system's primary informational link color.

items.name: Link Teal
items.role: doc-article inline link variant, paired with body text.

items.name: Accent Blue
items.role: + Accent Blue Soft (#dceaf6): "💡 Tip / Info" callout banner inside docs.

items.name: Accent Red
items.role: + Accent Red Soft (#f7d6d3): "⚠️ Warning / Caution" callout banner.

items.name: Accent Green
items.role: + Accent Green Soft (#d9eddf): "✅ Success / Positive" callout banner.

items.name: Accent Purple
items.role: + Accent Purple Soft (#e7d8ee): "📘 Note / Reference" callout banner.

items.name: Focus Ring
items.role: ): translucent blue browser-default focus ring around interactive elements.
